rationale: Continue the already specified common-effect gIVW estimand; do not choose the primary method by the resulting number of targets. Multiplicative dispersion remains a separate sensitivity.
candidate_rule: MVP P < 0.05/2709 and nominal P < 0.05 in at least one of FinnGen or Stuart; direction is separately annotated
enrichment_background: MVP estimable and at least one external outcome estimable, then unique gene identity and annotation coverage; no association P filter
enrichment_background_sensitivity: all MVP-estimable proteins, then the same gene/annotation filters
enrichment_BH_families: GO BP, MF, CC and KEGG separately; include zero-overlap eligible terms
clinical_primary_marker: retain original 17x22 family BH with n=374
clinical_secondary_marker: new candidate_count x 22 family BH, explicitly post hoc exploratory
MVP_free_control: FinnGen discovery with the same 2709 denominator; Stuart nominal same-direction support; FE and MRE, both LD branches
evidence_total_score: not computed; author score is separate; missing UKB is not filled
source_uncertainty: MVP CI confidence level and exported P/CI/SE convention unconfirmed; P-equivalent SE is a diagnostic only
